text:
FTP::enforce_tls_session_reuse
Description
This command enables or disables enforcing TLS session reuse, when
enabled, BIG-IP rejects the data connection if it fails to reuse
existed TLS session. Returns the current status if no option is
specified.
Syntax
FTP
::
enforce_tls_session_reuse
[
<
enable
|
disable
>
]
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
FTP
::
enforce_tls_session_reuse
enable
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
